newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Winsor Properties trades at HK$8.40.
newsitem.headline: Winsor Properties trades at HK$8.40.

text.p: Winsor Properties Holdings Ltd (WPHL) ended its debut morning on Friday to trade at a 29 percent discount to net tangible asset value at HK$8.40, a price deemed reasonable by analysts.
"This price level is is reasonable," said Dharmala Securities director Ben Kwong. "An average property stock usually trades at a discount of 20 to 30 percent."
Vickers Ballas sales director Antony Mak said such a share price was "normal" for a second-tier property concern.

In October, Winsor Industrial Corp Ltd said WPHL's net tangible asset value would be HK$11.86 per share after it acquired Winsor Industrial's properties by way of an issue of 129.84 million WPHL shares to Winsor Industrial.
WPHL was listed on Friday by way of introduction.
Analysts said the new listing saw lacklustre activity in its market debut.
"Trade has not been very active. But that's typical of listings by way of introduction," Kwong said.
A total of 1.59 shares were traded, translating into a turnover of HK$14.58 million.
